QJPS.settings.dateSort.name: Enable date sort selection
QJPS.settings.dateSort.hint: Allows to toggle sort buttons with the CTRL (control key) and use date sorting. This will sort the pages by creation date.
QJPS.ErrorSocketNotReady: Socketlib is not ready. Check that it is enabled and restart the world.
QJPS.WarnNoGM: A GM must be connected to sort journal pages.
QJPS.ErrorSortFailed: Journal sorting failed. See the console for details.
QJPS.InfoNoPages: The open journal contains no pages.
QJPS.settings.qjpsFontSize.name: Font Size
QJPS.settings.qjpsFontSize.hint: The font size will determine how big the buttons are going to be. For changes to take effect you probably need to trigger it manually by pressing F5.
